relations: Fog scatters light from the headlights and red beacons, creating soft halos around the sources.
The vehicle's white headlights surge and bloom, washing out its dark silhouette before settling into a steady glow.
The red warning lights and reflective bollards maintain their positions and brightness throughout the sequence.
caption: The video captures a foggy night scene on a paved road, where two large red warning lights glow in the upper center and a row of red-and-white reflective bollards lines a dark hedge on the right. A crack runs through the foreground pavement, and the camera perspective remains largely fixed. In the mid-ground a dark vehicle silhouette is already present, and a bright cluster of white headlights blooms from its front. The glare intensifies rapidly, washing out the silhouette as it swells in the mist. After this surge, the white light settles into a steady, diffused glow near the center-left distance. The red beacons remain constant overhead, their halos softened by the fog. Streetlights faintly illuminate the hedge and the right-hand structure. In the final frames the headlight glare still glows steadily through the haze, staying near the same position without a clear advance or recession.
